mapper.delete: delete from dwd_user_login_record where dates = #{dates} and source_id is null
mapper.select: select dulr2.id, t.* from (SELECT ll.user_id, ll.id source_id, ll.dates, ll.create_time, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, ll.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, ll.dates) register_day, ll.pvn version FROM ods_login_log ll INNER JOIN ods_user u on (ll.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) WHERE ll.dates = #{dates} and ll.id >= #{startSourceId} and ll.id <= #{endSourceId}) t left join dwd_user_login_record dulr2 on (t.source_id = dulr2.source_id)
